changelog: Added Overview tab showing the available checks in missions and the shop
Includes the option to toggle the visibility of orb checks
Added the option for auto tab tracking based on completed missions
Added preliminary images for room tabs and tracking
Maps for each Mission have been set up, fully up and running with logic and accurate placement.
These also come with some settings to change how much is shown.
Also some minor issues has been fixed.
All images are now theoretically centered and have a square format
Some images have their saturation and brightness cranked up to be more distinct from the disabled state
All items have been renamed to proper spelling, i.e. soulofsteel to Soul of Steel
Guns, styles and shop items are now vertically below the devil arms to save some space
Initial Release as simple visual item tracker
